description: Reference scenario s4-resubmit (base) on the synthetic student of fixtures/students/priya: "Resubmit after the draft grade". Load with env.load_seed at virtual_now 2027-03-08T09:00:00-05:00 with this binding.json and the package's fixtures/policies.json, then apply the base setup in ../scenario.json.

sources.description: Hand-written synthetic student, courses, AI policies, essays, comments, grades and course threads (fixtures/profiles/priya.json); recurring problems are planted across the graded essays. No external collection, no real people, courses or schools, and no third-party text.

Records written by hand for the scenario (examples/scenarios/s4-resubmit/scenario.json). Both members: Priya submitted v3 herself on Sunday night. Setup: on Monday Dr. Weiss grades it as a draft and asks for a new opening and a resubmission; on Wednesday evening Priya saves v4 with a new opening and both comma splices fixed in her own words.

transformations: Paragraphs split into sentences under second-draft-edit-kind/1, every seeded sentence authored by the student; versions numbered v1, v2, ... in saving order; policy entries, replies, submissions and grades given sequential IDs.
Scenario changes applied to the full fixture priya.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace the author's check of every record and human review of realism and variation.
